title: Lupin the 3rd Chronicles
native_title: ルパン三世 クロニクル
overview:
A two-disc animated reference guide made for the 30th anniversary of Lupin the 3rd. Browse data on the anime, from the first TV series through Part II and the films The Mystery of Mamo and The Castle of Cagliostro, illustrated with scenes from the shows.

- Comic Data Show: files on 130 chapters of the original manga
- Quiz elements to test your Lupin knowledge
- Two CD-ROMs
